name: engineering-agent-skills
description: Independent portable project bootstrap and risk-based single-/multi-Git engineering governance Skills.

interface.shortDescription: Project instructions and risk-based single-/multi-Git governance
interface.longDescription: Two independent Agent Skills. project-bootstrap initializes AGENTS.md with a stable .agents/rules/ directory instruction and maintains approved, evidenced rules entirely inside that directory. engineering-governance optionally covers change impact, verification, and reproducible releases for single- or multi-Git projects. The agent owns routine design, coding, tests and documentation; Grill and Wayfinder are optional.
defaultPrompt: Use project-bootstrap to reconcile AGENTS.md with only a stable .agents/rules/ directory policy; do not create rules by default.
Use project-bootstrap add-rule for this repeated, confirmed problem; maintain rules and any internal index within .agents/rules/ without editing AGENTS.md.
Use engineering-governance to assess a shared change affecting modules within one Git repository.
Use engineering-governance to verify and release a product using the appropriate one-Git or multi-Git strategy.
